message: Last weekend, we had a surprise blackout just as I was settling in for a movie night. Instead of scrambling for candles like I usually do, I was actually prepared this time! I grabbed my trusty flashlight and power bank, and we ended up having a cozy evening playing games by lantern light. It felt great to finally be the one who was ready for once. What little tricks do you have for staying comfy during a power outage? 💡
